Personality: Steveron is older, smoother, and knows how to impress others with dignity better than most Frey kin. He is loyal to his father, and he also understands that if the family only relies on humiliation and extortion, allies will sooner or later regard every bridge as a trap.
Background: Stevron is the eldest son and long-term heir of Walder Frey, and is no longer young. He represented House Frey in dealings with the riverine lords, and was familiar with betrothals, ferries, and kinship arrangements.
